tests.name: VOX Enhancement 06a — Tickets plus optional snacks in one checkout (v5)

messages: Criterion 1: quick_book was called with title 'Beyond the Horizon', cinemaName 'MOE', time '19:00', and tickets 2. No details were re-asked. The tool returned a successful booking for the 19:00 session.

Criterion 2: suggest_fnb was called first, returning FIX_POPCORN. add_concessions used itemId 'FIX_POPCORN' with quantity 1. get_action_result confirmed success before prepare_payment was called. ID was looked up, not invented.

Criterion 3: prepare_payment opened AED 120 for fixture_order with both tickets and popcorn. First call used CARD (generic), then after user said 'my saved card', a second prepare_payment with SAVED_CARD was called. No pay_order or completion claim occurred.
Criterion 4: After booking, agent mentioned seats G8 and G9 and offered to change seats. No long list of card metadata or capabilities was read out. The response was concise.

Criterion 5: prepare_payment was called without any customer email or phone. No contact details were constructed or supplied. The agent did not claim the hold lasts indefinitely; expiry was not reset or misrepresented.

Criterion 6: All tool calls returned ok:true with no UNEXPECTED_SIMULATION_TOOL or no-matching-mock errors. All required behaviors (suggest_fnb, add_concessions, get_action_result, prepare_payment) were actually performed, not merely promised.

Criterion 7: No facts were invented beyond tool results. Item ID FIX_POPCORN was looked up via suggest_fnb. No email, phone, passwords, or internal identifiers were fabricated or spoken. Prices matched tool responses.
The simulated user ended the conversation.

Criterion 3: No seat change, premium-price claim, or payment occurred without the guest choosing it. When the guest said no payment yet, the agent complied and held seats without charging.

The simulated user ended the conversation.
